A '''power core''' was an energy production facility that provided power for buildings and [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[City/Legends|Cities]] had numerous power cores built within their boundaries to provide energy to the various homes, facilities, and businesses established within. Colonies and encampments often had a more primitive form of power core, these being little more than an oversized energy cell. Rather than produce energy, it supplied power until it ran out. These smaller power cores were often used by survey teams, due to their much smaller impact on the environment. A damaged power core was used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]' destruction of it was one of the catalysts of the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]]. In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] ordered the shielding efficiency of the [[Mon Mothma (Imperial-class)|''Mon Mothma'']] to reduce at a set rate, tricking the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] into thinking its power core would explode. Ground-based power cores were used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal Naboo]], the Trade Federation, the Wookiees, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]], and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Most power cores built by various cultures included their cultural architecture and design aesthetics. Many [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] power cores utilized Wookiee architecture and had a light-orange central energy core, while many Gungan power cores were at least partially based in biotechnology and had a white-colored energy core. The Naboo built power cores that were fanciful in design and predominantly featured yellow and silver colors. The energy cores themselves were colored yellow.

Many Trade Federation bases across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] used power core structures to supply power to other nearby buildings, and were built by [[OX9]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]]. The central energy cores of the power cores were generally greenish-yellow. Probably the most infamous example of a Trade Federation power core was the one built on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] with the intention of powering other buildings. It was later abandoned after it was attacked by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]]. The power core was later destroyed by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Shoran]] when they found it.
